text: The Qatar Masters is organised by the Qatar Golf Association, whose president credited the Qatar Olympic Committee's support; Amnesty International reports that Qatar's migrant workers remain exposed to exploitation despite kafala reform and that expression and assembly are tightly restricted.
short: Qatar Masters run by the state golf federation; Amnesty documents migrant-worker exploitation and restricted expression

source.name: DP World Tour news (QGA launch announcement) + Amnesty International - Human rights in Qatar
